item.title: Artemis II simulated launch window opens tonight as NASA delays mission due to 'rare Arctic outbreak'
item.description: NASA's Artemis II simulated launch is scheduled for tonight after Arctic weather forced the mission to be delayed. The first crewed Artemis mega moon rocket could still leave Earth as early as this weekend.

item.title: The Colorado River's largest tributary flows 'uphill' for over 100 miles — and geologists may finally have an explanation for it
item.description: Millions of years ago, the Green River carved a path through the Uinta Mountains instead of flowing around the formation. Now, researchers have discovered how this could have happened.

item.title: Sunspot launches 27 solar flares in 24 hours, including strongest outburst in years
